Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Naturally Ornate Rug, 8' x 10', Charcoal
Colors: Charcoal
Materials: stone
Pile: 55% Polypropylene/ 45% Polyester, Backing: 100% Jute Imported Bring a distinctive focal point to your room with this rug. Elements of both vintage and modern design are crafted from soft textured fibers. Resistant to moisture, fading, staining, and static, it's ideal for a busy family. Modern and classic touches Machine woven. Made in Turkey. 55% polypropylene, 45% polyester Contemporary and classic touches 8' x 10' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
